name: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings
source:
You are a young adult adrift in life, suffocating under the yoke of your oppressive parents. Feeling out of sync with the rest of the world, you yearn for freedom and life beyond the bounds of your prison.

You find it in the form of a ravishing stranger and a long lost city, calling out to you across space and time. Something is beckoning underneath the ancient city's glimmering white tiles, something old and powerful. Someone.

Will you resist the call beyond the veil and the promise of belonging it brings, or will you let yourself go and embrace the path destiny has set before you?

The choice is yours. Magnustor is waiting for you.

[From [url=https://intimidatingpuffinstudios.itch.io/beyond-the-mist-beginnings-demo]itch.io[/url]]

Set in the same universe as [url=https://www.choiceofgames.com/user-contributed/soul-stone-war/]The Soul Stone War[/url].
translation:
你是一名在人生中随波逐流的年轻人，长期在专制父母的重压枷锁下喘不过气来。深感与周遭世界格格不入的你，满心渴望冲破这座无形牢笼，拥抱真正的自由与生活。

而这份自由终于以一位魅力夺魂的陌生人与一座失落已久的古城之姿向你显现，跨越时空向你发出呼唤。在古城熠熠生辉的洁白砖瓦之下，某种古老而强大的存在正在向你招手——那是某个人。

你究竟会抗拒帷幕彼端的呼唤及其许诺的归属感，还是彻底放开自我，坦然踏上命运为你铺就的道路？

抉择权在你手中。玛格努斯托正在等待你的到来。

[摘自[url=https://intimidatingpuffinstudios.itch.io/beyond-the-mist-beginnings-demo]itch.io[/url]]

与《[url=https://www.choiceofgames.com/user-contributed/soul-stone-war/]The Soul Stone War[/url]》共享同一世界观。
